OAL.d: Oriental Aromatics Limited manufactures specialty aroma chemicals, camphor, and fragrance ingredients. It supplies these products to global manufacturers of cosmetics, soaps, and household items.

OBEROIRLTY.d: Oberoi Realty Limited develops residential, commercial, and retail real estate properties primarily in Mumbai. It caters to premium home buyers and corporate tenants.

OFSS.d: The company provides IT solutions and software products specifically for the banking sector globally. It operates as a subsidiary of Oracle Corporation.

OIL.d: Oil India Limited is a state-owned enterprise engaged in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas. Its primary customers are domestic refineries and industrial consumers.

OLAELEC.d: Ola Electric Mobility Limited manufactures electric two-wheelers and lithium-ion cells. It is India's largest electric two-wheeler manufacturer by sales.

OLECTRA.d: Olectra Greentech manufactures electric buses and composite insulators for public transport authorities in India. It is a subsidiary of Megha Engineering and Infrastructures.

OMAXE.d: Omaxe Limited develops residential and commercial real estate projects, including townships, group housing, and retail spaces. Its primary customers are individual homebuyers and commercial enterprises across India.

ONEPOINT.ind: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
ONEPOINT.d: One Point One Solutions Limited provides business process outsourcing, customer care, and lead generation services. It serves clients across sectors such as telecommunications, banking, financial services, and e-commerce.

ONGC.d: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Limited explores for, develops, and produces crude oil and natural gas. It is a state-owned enterprise supplying domestic refineries and energy markets.

ONIDA.d: Mirc Electronics Limited manufactures and markets consumer electronics and home appliances under the Onida brand, serving retail consumers across India.

OPTIEMUS.d: Optiemus Infracom manufactures and distributes mobile phones and telecom accessories. It provides contract manufacturing services and works with major global telecom brands.

ORCHPHARMA.d: Orchid Pharma manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients and finished dosage formulations, focusing on cephalosporin antibiotics. Its products are supplied to global pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers.

ORICONENT.d: Oricon Enterprises Limited manufactures packaging products including metal closures, plastic containers, and pet preforms. It also has business interests in real estate development and petrochemicals.

ORIENTELEC.d: Orient Electric manufactures fans, lighting, and home appliances for residential and commercial customers. It is a prominent Indian consumer electricals company and part of the CK Birla Group.

ORIENTTECH.d: Orient Technologies Limited provides information technology solutions, including cloud and data management, IT infrastructure, and cybersecurity services. It serves banking, financial services, and enterprise clients in India.

ORISSAMINE.d: The Orissa Minerals Development Company mines and produces iron ore and manganese ore. It is a state-owned enterprise primarily supplying raw materials to the domestic steel industry.

OSWALPUMPS.d: Oswal Pumps manufactures a wide range of pumps, compressors, and diesel engines for agricultural, domestic, and industrial applications. It serves farmers, municipal corporations, and industrial clients across various domestic and export markets.
